'''Wax''' is the Matcha Flavoured name for the vanilla {{MCW|Honeycomb|honeycomb}}. It is still harvested from bee nests and beehives with shears, and is used to wax copper and to craft candles, beehives and a few of the pack's items.

== Obtaining ==
=== Harvesting and chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

=== Crafting ===
A honeycomb block can be crafted back into 4 wax, which vanilla ''Minecraft'' does not allow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/honeycomb_from_honeycomb_block.json}}</ref>

[[Tallow]], found in igloo chests, is a variant of wax that works the same way.

== Usage ==
Wax keeps its vanilla uses: using it on a copper block waxes the block, and it is crafted into candles, beehives and honeycomb blocks. The pack also uses it in:
* the [[Elegy of Icarus]] blessing (Feather Falling), with wind charges, feathers and a Hell-Bound Book;<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/feather_falling.json}}</ref>
* the Crete [[Music Disc|music disc]], with 8 disc fragments.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/music_disc_crete.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The rename applies to the item only; the honeycomb block keeps its name.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
